package quadratic
namespace quadratic
entity Integer id "quadratic://integer"
activity Adjust(Integer) -> Integer computes `if input < 0 {
    return input
}
let factor = __GOOO_BODY_HOLE_factor__
let adjustment = factor * factor
return input + adjustment` assembling {
    search hole "factor" grammar "integer-hole-residual/v1" intent "음수는 유지하고 나머지 입력에 9를 더한다. Preserve negative inputs; add nine otherwise." max_candidates "16"
    search_alternative "quadratic" grammar "integer-hole-quadratic/v1" max_candidates "16"
    case "2" -> "11"
    case "10" -> "19"
    attempts "8"
}
